new.title: New scene

editor.title: Edit scene
editor.quick_actions_hint: One-click prompts injected into the chat input for workspaces using this scene.
editor.agents_hint: Reference agents you've already created on the Agents page. When a Claude workspace mounts this scene, the selected agents are written into its .claude/agents/ directory; Codex workspaces have no subagent directory and are skipped.
editor.agents_none: No agents configured yet — add one on the Agents page.
editor.agents_missing: Referenced but not found for you: {{names}}
editor.advanced_title: Advanced definition (MCP / plugins / prompts / credentials / match)
editor.advanced_hint: The rest of the definition. Quick actions and agents above are merged in automatically — don't duplicate them here.
editor.adv_mcp_hint: Workspaces that mount this scene enable these MCP servers.
editor.adv_mcp_name: Pick or type an MCP name (e.g. fetch)
editor.adv_mcp_new_hint: Pick from MCP servers installed locally, or type a new name and paste its JSON config to save it on the scene — it's written into the workspace .mcp.json automatically on mount, no manual file editing.
editor.adv_plugins_hint: Claude marketplace plugins. Installed only after the user confirms in the workspace.
editor.adv_toolgroups_hint: Hide groups of niuniu built-in tools the agent doesn't need in this scene. Recommended for single-agent, no-repo scenes.
editor.adv_toolgroups_multi_agent_hint: Cross-agent shared blackboard and inbox messaging — only useful when several agents collaborate.
editor.adv_toolgroups_harness_hint: Git gate and pre-commit checks. Hidden automatically when there is no repo; restored once a repo is bound.
editor.adv_prompts_hint: Prompt fragments appended to the workspace CLAUDE.md.
editor.adv_ds_hint: Like a project's external sources: pick the configured data sources this scene needs. Workspaces that mount it reach them through the dataconn MCP (run_data_query) — no secrets are stored in the scene.
editor.adv_ds_missing: No data source named "{{name}}" — add one under Settings / Integrations.
editor.adv_kb_hint: Select the knowledge bases this scene uses. An mcp-kind KB is projected as an inline MCP server; local/url KBs are reached via kb_search / workspace mount.
editor.adv_kb_purpose: Purpose / how the agent uses this KB
editor.adv_kb_missing: No knowledge base named "{{name}}" - create one under Knowledge bases.
editor.adv_match_hint: Used to score this scene as a recommendation when creating a workspace.
editor.adv_env_hint: Environment-variable preset groups imported when this scene is mounted.
editor.adv_env_providers_hint: Mount subscription-platform providers directly: their base_url / models / API key expand into the right environment variables for each workspace's Agent type at spawn.
editor.adv_env_providers_empty: No providers yet — configure some under Settings → Environment Variables first.

pencil.title: OpenPencil canvas
pencil.hint: Design in the OpenPencil desktop app; the agent reads and writes the canvas over MCP, then turns the design into code.
pencil.launch_missing: OpenPencil is not installed — follow the prompt to download it
pencil.desktop_only: Available in the niuniu desktop app only
pencil.generate_prompt: Turn the current OpenPencil design into code: first read the full design structure via OpenPencil MCP (get_jsx / describe / node_tree), extract design tokens (design_to_tokens / analyze_*) as needed, confirm the target stack and scope with me, then generate code that follows this repo's design system (tokenized, semantic, responsive, dark-mode) into the workspace, and finally review the result against the design and list any differences. If the canvas isn't connected, remind me to open the OpenPencil app and document first.
